entities.name: Valerian Wellesley, 8th Duke of Wellington
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Brigadier Arthur Valerian Wellesley, 8th Duke of Wellington, styled Marquess of Douro between 1943 and 1972, was a British peer and army officer. His main residence was Stratfield Saye House in Hampshire.
